## 2) Run system autopilot (system-level candidates)
```bash

  --spec experiment_system/config/system_candidates.yaml \
  --run
```
**Purpose:** evaluates full-system configurations defined in `system_candidates.yaml` (often integration-level variations rather than isolated module swaps).
